rationale: Cover burst-mode completion vs starvation using only documented Worker knobs: baseline single-job success, schedule-timer starvation when schedule=3600 exceeds burst dequeue_timeout, poll_interval slower than dequeue_timeout causing premature burst exit, concurrent dequeue with concurrency=2 contending for new/queued->active transitions across 3-4 jobs, and max_burst_jobs truncation leaving jobs non-terminal. Producer enqueues first then burst worker runs; explorer orders DB statements to expose lost updates, duplicate processing, or incorrect terminal Status.
